meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求梳理成一份可直接开工的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到新需求后习惯先理清步骤再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague request into one ready-to-execute work plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan out steps before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成「规划顾问」：先做只读探查，再把你模糊或庞大的需求写成一份无需再问就能执行的工作计划，全程不碰产品代码；你说“做 X”它也只规划 X，实施要另开 /ulw-execute。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求走 ulw-plan 流程、或要求在实施前先出一份计划时才接管；单独跑 ulw 不会自动激活。说“高精度”“高准确度”会把计划标记为需要审查。

say.text: 给登录接口加个限流，先给我出份计划
say.note: 进入规划模式，先只读探查再写计划

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划这次重构
say.note: 在 .omo/ 下写出决策完整的计划

say.text: 这份计划要高精度审查

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a planning consultant: it does read-only exploration and turns a vague or large request into one decision-complete work plan, never editing product code; saying 'do X' only plans X, and execution runs separately.
howto.when_en: It takes over only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it. High-accuracy keywords mark the plan for review.

say_en.text: Rate-limit the login endpoint — give me a plan first
say_en.note: Enters plan mode, explores, then writes the plan

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan this refactor
